question: The hearts muscles contract and relax rhythmically, this rhythmic contraction followed by its relaxation constitute a heartbeat. Which instrument is used to measure heartbeats?
solution:
The corrrect answer is '**Stethoscope'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **walls of the chambers **of the heart are made up of muscles. These muscles **contract and relax** rhythmically.
 
• The **rhythmic contraction** of muscles is followed by its relaxation. This constitutes a **heartbeat.**
 
• The doctors use a **stethoscope **to listen to the heartbeat.
 
• It **amplifies** the so of the heartbeats which makes it easier for **the doctors to listen.**
